items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: I think it was Hibler, wasn't it?

ctx.x: Well then, afterwards, when that began to take, well it seems to me it was when Joya was in the band or something. Which of the girls -- one of the girls sang that all the time.
I don't know. I think it was Hibler, wasn't it?
Oh, yes, maybe it was. Because it was earlier than when those three girls were with the band, wasn't it?
